CREATE INDEX idx_business_legacy_links_task
                    on business_legacy_links(task_id, id)

CREATE TABLE business_legacy_links (
                    id integer primary key autoincrement,
                    signal_id integer,
                    task_id integer,
                    cluster_id integer,
                    anchor_id integer,
                    project_id integer,
                    project_candidate_id integer,
                    attention_item_id integer,
                    work_project_id integer unique,
                    work_todo_id integer unique,
                    work_update_id integer unique,
                    created_at text not null default current_timestamp,
                    check(
                        (signal_id is not null) + (task_id is not null) + (cluster_id is not null)
                        + (anchor_id is not null) + (project_id is not null)
                        + (project_candidate_id is not null) + (attention_item_id is not null) = 1
                    ),
                    check(
                        (work_project_id is not null) + (work_todo_id is not null)
                        + (work_update_id is not null) = 1
                    ),
                    foreign key(signal_id) references actions(business_signal_public_id),
                    foreign key(task_id) references business(task_public_id),
                    foreign key(cluster_id) references business(work_cluster_public_id),
                    foreign key(anchor_id) references business(anchor_public_id),
                    foreign key(project_id) references business(project_public_id),
                    foreign key(project_candidate_id) references business(project_candidate_public_id),
                    foreign key(attention_item_id) references business(attention_item_public_id),
                    foreign key(work_project_id) references business(work_project_public_id),
                    foreign key(work_todo_id) references business(work_todo_public_id),
                    foreign key(work_update_id) references actions(id)
                )

CREATE TRIGGER trg_sync_legacy_link_parent_insert after insert on business_legacy_links when new.work_update_id is not null and not exists(select 1 from actions a where a.id=new.work_update_id and a.record_type='work_updates') begin select raise(abort,'work update parent type mismatch'); end

CREATE TRIGGER trg_sync_legacy_link_parent_update after update of work_update_id on business_legacy_links when new.work_update_id is not null and not exists(select 1 from actions a where a.id=new.work_update_id and a.record_type='work_updates') begin select raise(abort,'work update parent type mismatch'); end

CREATE TABLE emails (
    id integer primary key,
    classification_id integer unique,
    message_id integer not null unique,
    account_id text not null,
    stable_message_identity text not null unique,
    uidvalidity integer not null check(uidvalidity > 0),
    uid integer not null check(uid > 0),
    class_folder text,
    class_rfc_message_id text,
    class_thread_id text,
    class_sender text,
    class_subject text,
    class_preview text,
    class_model_text text,
    class_received_at text,
    class_category text,
    class_predicted_category text,
    class_confirmed_category text,
    class_confidence real,
    class_margin real,
    class_probabilities_json text,
    class_model_id text,
    class_config_version text,
    class_status text,
    class_classification_source text,
    class_agent_result_json text,
    class_current_action_plan_id text,
    class_included_in_model_id text,
    class_legacy_processed_without_plan integer,
    class_confirmed_at text,
    class_created_at text,
    class_updated_at text,
    message_folder text not null,
    message_rfc_message_id text not null,
    message_in_reply_to text not null default '',
    message_references_json text not null default '[]' check(json_valid(message_references_json)),
    message_thread_identity text not null,
    message_sender text not null,
    message_recipients_json text not null check(json_valid(message_recipients_json)),
    message_subject text not null,
    message_normalized_text text not null,
    message_preview text not null,
    message_attachment_metadata_json text not null check(json_valid(message_attachment_metadata_json)),
    message_received_at text not null,
    message_created_at text not null,
    message_updated_at text not null,
    check(classification_id is null or (
        class_folder is not null and class_sender is not null and
        class_subject is not null and class_preview is not null and
        class_model_text is not null and class_received_at is not null and
        class_confidence is not null and class_margin is not null and
        class_probabilities_json is not null and class_model_id is not null and
        class_config_version is not null and class_status is not null and
        class_classification_source is not null and class_agent_result_json is not null and
        class_legacy_processed_without_plan in (0,1) and
        class_confirmed_at is not null and class_created_at is not null and
        class_updated_at is not null
    ))
)
